eligible_item_types: open implementation/PR decision with objective merge-or-close terminal
formal conjecture/proof challenge with later native proof or counterexample
public benchmark/standard decision with a pre-existing objective resolution mechanism
eligibility: At freeze time the final outcome must not yet exist; the item must have a public immutable identifier, evidence snapshot, and a resolution rule not controlled by the ORION evaluation.
study_close_rule: Score when at least 20 eligible items have objectively resolved or 180 days after the item-manifest commit, whichever comes later; at close, unresolved eligible items remain unresolved rather than being removed.
authority_ceiling: genuine temporal prospective evidence over the frozen public item population; not a universal reliability claim
